# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability edited: **system-prompt only** (`prompt.md`). No tools.py in the edit space.
Method: 3 read-only diagnosis subagents (sheet-level cluster, cell-level cluster, passing-tasks/418-29), then serial synthesis + one prompt rewrite.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Code not general across the 3 HIDDEN test-case inputs (differ in size/values/control-cell choice). Agent hardcodes dims from answer_position (418-29 `max_row=7`), hardcodes answers (52216 t2), reads control value from wrong cell / fixed rows (52216), off-by-one table location (53161) | 52216, 418-29, 160-6, 53161 (flaky) + partial [1,0,0]/[1,1,0] | Assumptions baked from the single visible input only pass the matching test case | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt: multi-input contract + data-driven rules |
| 2 | `answer_position` treated as source extent / operating window instead of graded OUTPUT window | 160-6, 347-49 | For delete/shift, must operate on whole sheet so outside rows flow in | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt: answer_position semantics |
| 3 | Formula cells read without `data_only=True` → formula TEXT returned, skipped → wrong sums | 374-9 (0.00 all trials) | openpyxl default returns `"=SUM(...)"` string | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt: data_only rule |
| 4 | Coordinate mapping / structure preservation clarity + no self-check | cross-cutting | pandas header/index offsets; no read-back verify | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt: coords + verify step |
| — | 32468 (0.00) rolling 12-vs-13-month window boundary | 32468 | pure logic; needs ground-truth to pin off-by-one | (logic) | covered only by general inspect/verify guidance; not special-cased |
| — | 55457 (0.00) | 55457 | instruction field is genuinely EMPTY — agent cannot know the task | (data defect) | skipped, unfixable via prompt |

## Changes made this iteration (all in prompt.md; all ADDITIVE knowledge, none loosen a decision rule)
| cluster | edit class | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Add missing rule (grounded in grading behavior) | "How you are graded": code is re-run on several inputs of differing size/values/control cells → size loops from live data (`ws.max_row`), read control cells live, match keys, never hardcode answers/dims | 47484 already reads dynamically; 40467 is Cell-Level D1:D10 fixed-size (writes stay in exact cells) → no behavior change |
| 2 | Add missing rule | answer_position = graded OUTPUT window, not source extent/operating window; whole-sheet delete/shift for blank-row tasks | neither passing task is a delete/shift task |
| 3 | Add missing rule + worked detail | read formula results with `load_workbook(path, data_only=True)`; default returns formula text | passing tasks don't aggregate over formula cells |
| 4 | Clarify contract + example + reorder | absolute A1 coords, worked `E2:H5`→rows2-5/cols5-8, openpyxl exact-cell targeting, pandas offset/`to_excel` caveat; read-back verify before finishing; inspect-first | endorses techniques the passing tasks already use (openpyxl exact cells / dynamic pandas) |

Kept ALL six original constraints (Cell/Sheet modify-only, prefer literals, save-to-output_path+mkdir, read-carefully, error→fix-don't-repeat) — consolidated, none dropped.

## Verify-the-fix (per change: failing trace → what the new knowledge changes)
- Cluster1 / 418-29 t0: code did `iter_rows(max_row=7)` from answer_position A1:B7 → failed hidden cases [2,3] (test_case_results [1,0,0]). New rule "size loops from ws.max_row, never from answer_position" makes it read all rows (as passing t1–t4 already do). Verified vs passing 47484 (already dynamic) / 40467 (Cell-Level fixed cells) → no behavior change.
- Cluster1 / 52216 t0,t2,t3: read region from wrong sheet / hardcoded numbers / fixed rows → partial. New rules "read control cell live + match keys, never hardcode answers" match passing t1/t4. Passing tasks read no control cell → unaffected.
- Cluster2 / 160-6 t0,t4: searched blanks only inside A6:L11 (the answer window) → range stayed blank. New rule "operate on whole sheet with delete_rows so outside rows flow in" matches passing t2/t3. Passing tasks are not delete/shift → unaffected.
- Cluster3 / 374-9 all trials: summed cells holding `=SUM(...)`; isinstance guard skipped strings → wrong totals (0/3). Confirmed openpyxl default returns formula text (reproduced locally: `A3` = `'=SUM(A1:A2)'`). New `data_only=True` rule yields cached numbers. Passing tasks don't read formula values → unaffected.
- Coordinate example verified: `column_index_from_string` E=5,F=6,G=7,H=8; E2:H5 = rows 2–5, cols 5–8. Correct.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 3 parallel read-only `general-purpose` agents diagnosed the sheet-level, cell-level, and passing/418-29 clusters across all 5 trials each. The passing-task agent REFUTED the "openpyxl-vs-pandas is the cause" hypothesis (47484 passes on pure pandas; 418-29's failing trial uses openpyxl) — steering the fix toward data-semantics/generalization, not mechanics.
- Prior iterations: none (this is the seed; LEDGER/RUNMAP/JOURNAL empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not undo)
- The "code is graded on multiple hidden inputs → write data-driven, dimension-agnostic code" contract is the single highest-leverage insight; keep it at the top.
- `data_only=True` rule for formula reads (fixes 374-9's whole cluster deterministically).
- All six original constraints.

## Deliberately skipped
- 55457: instruction field is empty (data defect) — no prompt can supply the missing task.
- 32468: rolling-window boundary is a pure arithmetic-interpretation error needing the graded expected values to pin the off-by-one; not special-cased (would overfit). Relies on general inspect/verify + dynamic-read guidance.
